workloads.label: Broader comparison · 150 findings
workloads.note: 50 evidence packets, 150 primary findings and 50 separate diagnostics. Author-defined development labels across 25 related scenarios and 15 insurance families. Results are not independent externally adjudicated cases.
workloads.timing: Median request-to-validated completion. Reported charges exclude unresolved failed-call charges. Runs occurred at different times.

workloads.label: Classify text-state · 150 findings
workloads.note: Same 50 packets, questions and keys as the broader comparison, but the complete structured evidence is losslessly serialized as JSON text to meet the ScaleDown API contract. Original object-state requests were rejected. Separate input-format diagnostic; not a matched-format leaderboard. No image evaluation.
workloads.timing: Median end-to-end completion; reported charges. Original rejected attempts remain reserved separately.

workloads.label: Quick screen · 30 findings
workloads.note: 10 packets, 30 primary findings and 10 separate diagnostics. Small screening workload, not the broader benchmark. FP4 and BF16 provider routes remain separate measurements.
workloads.timing: Saved median end-to-end times; reused rows may lack exact run dates. Cost per 1,000 four-question packets.

workloads.label: Core · 180 packets
workloads.note: Frozen related submission scenarios. Author keys await independent review. Core and exploratory subsets have different denominators. Binary compares only identical boolean questions.
workloads.timing: Historical successful-request medians exclude retry waits. API timing includes network; local timing is in-process. Binary cost/time covers original requests: 10 mixed questions for general models versus 3 for Span. Do not interpret this as matched binary-only serving cost.
